transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm... I'm just here because my family wanted me to come. They keep saying those bank papers prove nothing happened. But... I know they're hiding my money. It's been over a year. They use things like bills, or... fundraisers, or talking about trips to cover it up. I just... I have to keep asking them about it until they tell me the truth. But they won't listen.
Do you believe that your family is working together or conspiring against you in any way?

I mean... I just said that. They all say the exact same things about the bank papers. Even my friends do it now. They all act like nothing was taken. 

So... yeah. They all use the same excuses to cover it up. The bills, the trips... they're all doing it. I just... I have to keep confronting them until somebody finally tells the truth. That's all.
Do you believe that people who are not directly involved, like strangers or organizations, are also part of this?
No. Just... just them. I don't... I don't talk to strangers. It's just my family and the people I know. I don't know anything about... organizations or whatever. It's just them.
Do you have any other strong beliefs that others are lying to you or deceiving you, aside from the belief about your money being hidden?
No. It's... it's just the money. I don't know what else you mean. They just... they took it, and they're lying about that. Nothing else.
